title: CI grep test banning raw MATCH strings
instructions: Add a CI step in .github/workflows/ci.yml that greps src/ferrite/*.py for raw 'MATCH' strings (banned per §6.3 — all Cypher must go through a query builder that injects namespace filters). The grep should fail the build if raw MATCH is found in handler code (excluding test files and the query.py builder itself). Example: grep -rn 'MATCH' src/ferrite/*.py | grep -v query.py | grep -v test_ && exit 1 || true
